programs.title: Be-Shaque
programs.desc: When the owner of a tea estate dies under mysterious circumstances, a series of bizarre events follow. The owner's friend Prakash (Mithun Chakraborty) then arrives in the village to find out what really happened. But he gets further drawn into the mystery as he follows a shadowy figure into the jungle and discovers an abandoned haunted house.
